description: Per-character bundle of CharacterAnimation group IDs that defines which montage sets are preloaded and installed for a character.

Id.simple: Character ID used as the row key.
Id.technical: Unreal DataTable row name (exported as ID). CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterAnimationSet selects it, with FStudioBattleCharacterOverrides.AnimationSetIdOverride taking priority in battle/level-sequence setup. The export has 52 rows.

Id_CharacterAnimation.simple: Ordered list of CharacterAnimation group IDs belonging to the set.
Id_CharacterAnimation.technical: TArray<FName>; all 52 exported rows have 31 slots with None placeholders. Each non-None ID is resolved against CharacterAnimationDataTables. BattleAssets_AnimMontages_12BC030 appends every resolved row's FileName entries to a preload list; battle and sequencer character installs instead loop the resolved rows and bind each Key/FileName pair. None entries are skipped; a missing animation row is skipped rather than fatal.

notes: This is a join table only: it contains no montage names itself; the cross-table chain is AnimationSet -> CharacterAnimation -> FileName -> AnimMontage primary-asset loader.
CP_010's exported set mixes the base character group with facial, guard, step, jump and attack groups and several None slots; other sets may differ.
FindDataTableAnimationSetRow / BattleStory_FindRowOutOfLine implement the shared first-matching-table row search over the manager's CharacterAnimationSetDataTables array.
No localization variants of this table were exported; available Content is partial. Evidence is reconstructed source, not a retail byte-match claim.

usages.detail: Shared finder resolves the set row by id over CharacterAnimationSetDataTables.
Walks Id_CharacterAnimation and appends each animation row's FileName array to the montage preload names.
Uses Id_CharacterAnimationSet to create anim-montage primary asset loaders for battle characters.
Applies a studio AnimationSetIdOverride when present, otherwise the character's set id, during battle character setup.
Iterates set IDs to install keyed montages on the spawned character.
Resolves the set for sequencer characters and preloads its montages.
Out-of-line shared row finder used by widget/battle phases to look up CharacterAnimationSet rows.
